text: …ピピちゃん　こんど　あそびに　いきたい　です　ヤマブキ　シティでは　ロケットだんの　じけんが　おおい　そうですね　クチバは　そうでも　ありません…

structure.jp: こんど　あそびに　いきたい　です
structure.en: I'd like to come visit sometime

structure.jp: ヤマブキ　シティでは　ロケットだんの　じけんが　おおい　そうですね
structure.en: I hear there are many Team Rocket incidents in Saffron City

structure.jp: クチバは　そうでも　ありません…
structure.en: Vermilion isn't so much like that...

patterns.name: 〜に (purpose)
patterns.span: あそびに　いきたい
patterns.explanation: A verb stem plus に before 'go' tells what you are going there to do. あそびにいきたい = 'I want to go and visit'.

patterns.name: 〜そうだ (hearsay)
patterns.explanation: そうだ after a full plain word says you heard this from someone else. おおいそうです = 'I hear there are many'.

patterns.name: 〜たい
patterns.explanation: たい after a verb says you want to do it. いきたい = 'I want to go'.
